channel.title: Matemplates Blog — n8n Automations & Workflow Builds
channel.description: Practical n8n automation guides for solopreneurs and small teams: Telegram sale alerts, cold outreach that converts, invoice follow-ups, support triage, and lead enrichment — with real workflow teardowns.

item.title: 5 n8n Automations Every Solopreneur Should Steal in 2026
item.description: The five n8n workflows that quietly run a one-person business: support triage, invoice chasing, sale alerts, cold outreach, and lead enrichment — what each does and where to start.

item.title: Never Miss a Gumroad Sale: Build a Telegram Alert in 5 Minutes
item.description: A step-by-step build of a Gumroad webhook to Telegram sale alert, plus the auto-welcome email and review follow-up that turn one-time buyers into repeat ones.

item.title: Cold Outreach That Doesn't Sound Like a Robot (n8n Edition)
item.description: How to turn a flat lead sheet into personalized, throttled emails that protect your domain — rule-based with zero API cost, with an LLM swap-in when you want it.

item.title: n8n vs Zapier for Solopreneurs: The Real Pricing & Control Trade-off
item.description: Where Zapier's per-task pricing quietly breaks a solopreneur budget, and why self-hosting n8n changes the math — without the hype.

item.title: How to Auto-Chase Overdue Invoices with n8n (Without Losing Clients)
item.description: A polite, staged dunning sequence built in n8n: gentle at day 1, firm at day 7, final at day 14 — with dry-run mode so your first pass sends zero real emails.

item.title: How We Built a Real Estate Lead Scraper & AI Scorer in n8n
item.description: A teardown of the flagship real-estate lead enrichment workflow: scrape, AI-score, dedupe, and route hot leads to Telegram — with a test mode that runs on dummy data first.

item.title: Build a No-Code CRM in Google Sheets with n8n
item.description: Learn how to build a powerful, automated no-code CRM in Google Sheets using n8n for lead capture, upserting, and real-time alerts without SaaS bills.

item.title: n8n Error Handling: Stop Losing Runs (and Leads) Silently
item.description: Master n8n error handling: set up global Error Trigger workflows, handle retries, and stop losing critical automation runs and leads silently.

item.title: How to Enrich Leads from Any Source with n8n
item.description: Learn how to enrich leads from any source using n8n — connect enrichment APIs, score prospects, and route qualified leads automatically.

item.title: n8n Webhook to Telegram: The Only Trigger You Actually Need
item.description: Set up the n8n Telegram Trigger node once: create a bot with BotFather, add the credential, and let n8n register the webhook so messages reach your workflow in seconds.

item.title: n8n Webhook Idempotency: Stop Double Charges and Duplicate Emails
item.description: Webhook providers retry on timeout, so your n8n workflow runs twice and fires the side effect twice. Build an idempotency gate with Respond to Webhook, a key check, and a Data Table.

item.title: n8n Backup & Restore: Save a Self-Hosted Instance From Total Loss
item.description: Back up a self-hosted n8n instance properly: export workflows and credentials, save the encryption key, and restore from a clean database in the right order.

item.title: n8n Binary Data: How to Attach a PDF to an Email Without the Mystery Error
item.description: Understand n8n binary data and fix attachments: match the binary property name to your Gmail node, carry binary through Code and Set nodes, and pick the right binary storage mode for a self-hosted instance.
